contexts.text: Such are distinguished by this, that they act in a quadruped manner... SE 1819.
If man were born into the love of the neighbour... he would indeed at first creep like a quadruped, but with the implanted endeavour to raise himself up...
When a Spirit is being inaugurated (into a gyre), he is driven into a quadruplicate step, so that the sound is like a quadruped... SE 1127.
There are Spirits who speak in a quadruped manner. Described.
